_comment: The app's auto-renewing subscription, read by play_subscriptions.py and asc_subscriptions.py. Prices are USD; each store converts them for other countries. Prime Lifetime is a one-time purchase, not a subscription, so it's created in the store consoles (see store_listing/). Product ids must match what the billing code queries.

en-US.name: Prime Monthly
en-US.description: Unlimited cleaning and every scan, monthly
benefits: SD card, USB and custom folders

subscriptions.review_note: Removes the free limits (100 files and 500 MB per clean) and unlocks every scan type, storage location and filter. Restore is on the paywall.
